def _panel_maps(panel_a, panel_b):
    (u, v) = (np.asarray(panel_a[k], dtype=float) for k in ('u', 'v'))
    (offset, gain) = (np.empty(u.shape[1]), np.empty(u.shape[1]))
    for j in range(u.shape[1]):
        (a, b) = (u[:, j], v[:, j])
        (i, k) = np.triu_indices(len(a), 1)
        dx = a[k] - a[i]
        ok = np.abs(dx) > 0.1 * np.ptp(a)
        slope = np.median((b[k[ok]] - b[i[ok]]) / dx[ok])
        bias = np.median(b - a * slope)
        residual = b - (bias + slope * a)
        mad = np.median(np.abs(residual))
        keep = np.abs(residual) <= max(6 * mad, 1e-10)
        if keep.sum() >= 2 and np.ptp(a[keep]) > 0:
            (bias, slope) = np.linalg.lstsq(_affine(a[keep, None]), b[keep], rcond=None)[0]
        (offset[j], gain[j]) = (bias, slope)
    (u, v) = (np.asarray(panel_b[k], dtype=float) for k in ('u', 'v'))
    operator = np.linalg.lstsq(_affine(u), v, rcond=None)[0]
    return (offset, gain, operator)

def _calibrate(panel):
    (u, v) = (np.asarray(panel[k], dtype=float) for k in ('u', 'v'))
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(len(u), 1)
    (bias, gain) = (np.empty(u.shape[1]), np.empty(u.shape[1]))
    for (k, (a, b)) in enumerate(zip(u.T, v.T)):
        dx = a[j] - a[i]
        ok = abs(dx) > 0.1 * np.ptp(a)
        g = np.median((b[j[ok]] - b[i[ok]]) / dx[ok])
        r = b - g * a
        m = np.median(r)
        keep = abs(r - m) <= max(1e-06, 8 * np.median(abs(r - m)))
        (bias[k], gain[k]) = np.linalg.lstsq(_affine(a[keep, None]), b[keep], rcond=None)[0]
    return (bias, gain)

def _predict(study, kind='powered', y_form='sparse', traj_form='linear'):
    tr = study['train']
    (b, g) = _calibrate(study['panel_a'])
    operator = _panel_operator(study['panel_b'], kind)
    w = operator((np.asarray(tr['x']) - b) / g)
    wt = operator((np.asarray(study['test']['x']) - b) / g)
    Y = np.asarray(tr['y'])
    T = np.asarray(tr['traj'])
    F = _relaxation(np.asarray(study['eval_times']), T)
    y_hat = _features(wt, y_form) @ np.linalg.lstsq(_features(w, y_form), Y, rcond=None)[0]
    amplitudes = _features(wt, traj_form) @ np.linalg.lstsq(_features(w, traj_form), T @ np.linalg.pinv(F), rcond=None)[0]
    state_pred = amplitudes @ F
    return (y_hat, state_pred)
